'''T'kor''' was the [[Deity/Legends|god]] of [[heat storm]]s, revered by the [[Kriek]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kriekaal]]. Kriek made sacrifices of [[Lichen/Legends|lichen]] to T'kor in the wake of heat storms that swept their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Scout" />
